title: Canvas (Instructure) is the campus LMS with SAML login
summary: CSUSB publishes Canvas resources and links to https://csusb.instructure.com/login/saml. Course activity, grades-adjacent workflows, and learning-app launches concentrate here -- a primary student-data plane for the investigation.
student_action: Include Canvas in every self-audit; review installed course apps before launching them.
school_action: Publish Canvas data categories, retention, and approved learning-app inventory with DPAs.
